item.title: refactor(agents): split cli-runner into concept modules (#122442)
item.summary: refactor(agents): split cli-runner into concept modules (#122442) * refactor(agents): split CLI runner concepts * chore(lint): ratchet cli-runner max-lines baseline * refactor(agents): remove stale runner import * refactor(agents): preserve cleanup error typing * refactor(agents): disambiguate CLI backend predicate * test(agents): align code-mode pending boundary Fixes red main: both host calls are unsettled when the guest snapshot is first parked; later waits still prove that settled calls are filtered. * test(agents): tolerate code-mode settlement race Fixes red main: the fast host call may settle as the guest snapshot is parked, while the deliberately slow call must remain pending.
